set: A: the key `marketing-top`, whole and in native crops, each beside the approved image

issues.where: both orange buttons (hero 'Apply for a Job' and header button)
issues.what: the plastic is a dark burnt red-brown with a glossy top-left gradient sheen; the target is a bright, saturated warm orange with a soft, near-matte satin finish and only a gentle top highlight
issues.fix: raise lightness and saturation toward a clean orange (about #E0662A), flatten the gradient to a soft satin sheen, and remove the strong specular streak at upper left

issues.where: the three benefit cards and the ticker bar
issues.what: the glass reads as dark, opaque grey-green plastic slabs with heavy dark bevels and dark drop shadows; the target is pale, cool, frosted, translucent glass, much lighter than the page tone, with a thin bright edge highlight and a faint soft shadow
issues.fix: lighten the glass body substantially and cool it (pale blue-grey), add translucency, thin the bevel to a bright 1-2px edge rim, and soften and lighten the shadow under each slab

issues.what: the arrow is a grey-gradient chrome/pearl 3D object with a thin edge and a slimmer, narrower head; the target is a flat bright-white enamel arrow with a thick crisp black outline, a wider head, and a short, distinct shadow cast down-right
issues.fix: make the fill flat white with little gradient, thicken the black edge to a bold outline, widen the arrowhead to the target's proportions, and give it a tighter, darker contact shadow to the lower right

issues.what: the metal is darker mid-grey with concentric lathe-turned rings and high-contrast chrome rims, and the teeth are sharp triangles; the target is a brighter satin brushed steel with soft warm highlights, rounded scalloped teeth and a softer rim
issues.fix: brighten the steel, change the concentric turning to a fine directional brush, reduce rim contrast, round the teeth into scallops, and shorten and lighten the shadow to the right

issues.what: type weight is semibold/medium; the target sets the headline, the wordmark and the card titles in a heavy bold with tight tracking and near-black colour
issues.fix: set those lines in bold/extra-bold, tighten letter-spacing slightly, and darken to near-black

issues.what: labels are a bold pinkish grey; the target uses an off-white regular-to-medium weight label
issues.fix: use a cream/off-white label colour at medium weight

issues.where: page surface over the whole frame
issues.what: the page is greyer and dimmer with a mottled noise grain; the target is a brighter warm off-white with a fine paper-fibre grain
issues.fix: lift brightness and warm the page tone, and replace the mottled noise with a fine, low-contrast fibrous paper grain

issues.where: all cast shadows (buttons, medal, cards, ticker)
issues.what: shadows are darker, longer and harder toward lower right than the target's soft, short, light shadows
issues.fix: reduce shadow opacity and offset, and increase blur so the parts sit close to the page

issues.what: links are a lighter grey than the target's dark near-black
issues.fix: darken the nav text toward the body ink colour

issues.what: the rule is thicker and darker with a chrome highlight; the target is a thin, light grey metal line
issues.fix: thin the rule and lighten it to a soft grey with a faint highlight

issues.where: crops 'the large button' and 'the button in the header'
issues.what: at native size the orange is dark brick red with a glossy gradient and a black-and-white chrome ring; the target shows bright satin orange inside a soft light-grey metal bezel
issues.fix: same as the full frame: brighten to clean orange, satin finish, and a softer grey bezel without the black inner line

issues.where: crops 'a corner of a glass card', 'glass at its edge', 'the words on a card', 'the ticker'
issues.what: the glass is opaque mid grey-green with a dark rounded bevel and a dark lower shadow; the target's glass is pale, cool and translucent with a thin bright rim and a faint shadow
issues.fix: lighten and cool the glass, add translucency, and use a thin bright rim and a soft light shadow

issues.what: a glossy grey chrome arrow with a thin outline and slim head, against the target's flat white enamel arrow with a thick black outline
issues.fix: flat white fill, thick black outline, wider head, crisper short shadow down-right

issues.what: darker, concentric-turned chrome with sharp teeth and a strong dark shadow, against the target's bright brushed satin steel with rounded scallops
issues.fix: brighten, brush the metal finish, round the teeth, soften the shadow

issues.what: headline and wordmark are lighter in weight, and the rule is heavier and darker than in the target
issues.fix: heavier bold type with tight tracking; a thin light-grey rule

issues.what: the grain is a mottled grey noise, where the target has a fine warm paper fibre
issues.fix: use a fine fibrous warm paper texture at low contrast
